description.en: Meet Juno, the AI business journalist behind The GaloreGrowth Podcast. Discover his personality, his creator, and a preview of his first interview.
description.zh: 认识 The GaloreGrowth Podcast 的 AI 商业记者 Juno，了解他的个性、创作者，以及首场访谈的预告。

description.en: Juno interviews his creator, GaloreGrowth.ai founder Guno Sutiono, about four technology revolutions, the opportunities and challenges of AI, and beginning a new entrepreneurial chapter at 62.
description.zh: Juno 专访他的创作者、GaloreGrowth.ai 创始人 Guno Sutiono，畅谈亲历四次科技革命、人工智能带来的机遇与挑战，以及62岁开启创业新篇章的故事。

title.en: AI in Action: From Vision to Real Impact in Financial Services
title.zh: AI 实践：从愿景到金融服务的真实影响

description.en: What does it take to move AI beyond the buzzwords and create meaningful results in financial services? In Episode 2 of The GaloreGrowth Podcast, AI host Juno sits down with Bill Pienias, President of FinFit Life, to explore the journey from vision to practical impact. The conversation puts the spotlight on real business needs, responsible adoption, and the human judgment required to turn promising technology into lasting value. Join us for a business-focused discussion about the opportunities and questions shaping the next chapter of financial services.
description.zh: 人工智能如何超越概念与口号，在金融服务业创造真正有意义的成果？在《The GaloreGrowth Podcast》第二集中，AI 主持人 Juno 对话 FinFit Life 总裁 Bill Pienias，探讨如何从 AI 愿景走向实际应用与商业价值。本集聚焦真实业务需求、审慎采用新技术，以及将技术潜力转化为长期价值所需要的人类判断力。一同思考 AI 为金融服务业带来的机遇，以及企业在迈向下一阶段时值得关注的问题。

description.en: In this conversation, China business advisor and mentor Samuel Hung explores how the rise of AI is reshaping entrepreneurship — and why he is now helping founders plan for the OPC (One Person Company) model. A bestselling author, sales strategist, team-building expert and speaker, Hung shares how entrepreneurs can combine personal expertise, AI tools, automation and business design to create a leaner company with greater individual leverage. The discussion also looks at what should remain human: judgment, communication, trust and leadership. The goal is not AI for its own sake, but a practical OPC built around real business value.
description.zh: 在这段访谈中，中国企业顾问与导师、畅销书作者洪豪泽（Samuel Hung）谈 AI 崛起如何改变创业方式，以及他为何正在帮助企业家规划 OPC（One Person Company，一人公司）。洪老师长期专注于销售技巧、团队建设与企业辅导，并活跃于演讲与培训领域。访谈进一步讨论：当 AI 把过去需要多人协作的工作逐步自动化，一个创业者如何把个人专业能力、AI 工具、流程与商业模式重新组合，形成更轻、更快、更具杠杆效应的公司结构；同时也探讨哪些能力仍必须由人来判断、沟通、建立信任与领导。重点不是为了用 AI 而用 AI，而是如何用 AI 重新设计一家真正围绕商业价值、可持续经营的 OPC。
